mapper.sql: v.videoID AS videoId, v.userID AS userId, v.title AS title, v.description AS description, TIME_FORMAT(v.duration, '%H:%i:%s') AS duration, v.uploadDate AS uploadDate, v.videoSrcUrl AS videoSrcUrl, v.videoImgUrl AS videoImgUrl, u.nickname AS authorNickname, u.imgUrl AS authorAvatarUrl, c.categoryID AS categoryId, c.categoryName AS categoryName, v.viewCount AS viewCount, v.likeCount AS likeCount, v.favoriteCount AS favoriteCount, v.barrageCount AS barrageCount, v.commentCount AS commentCount, v.reviewStatus AS reviewStatus
FROM video v INNER JOIN `user` u ON v.userID = u.userID LEFT JOIN videocategory vc ON v.videoID = vc.videoID AND vc.enable = 1 LEFT JOIN categorie c ON vc.categoryID = c.categoryID
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE v.videoID = #{videoId} AND v.enable = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT
WHERE v.reviewStatus = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1 ORDER BY v.uploadDate DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
WHERE v.reviewStatus = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1
AND vc.categoryID = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY v.viewCount DESC, v.uploadDate DESC ORDER BY v.likeCount DESC, v.uploadDate DESC ORDER BY v.uploadDate DESC

SELECT
WHERE v.reviewStatus = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1
AND (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY v.viewCount DESC, v.uploadDate DESC ORDER BY v.likeCount DESC, v.uploadDate DESC ORDER BY v.uploadDate DESC
SELECT DISTINCT v.title FROM video v WHERE v.reviewStatus = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1 AND v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY v.viewCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
INNER JOIN follow f ON f.followedID = v.userID AND f.followerID = #{userId} AND f.enable = 1 WHERE v.reviewStatus = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1 ORDER BY v.uploadDate DESC

SELECT
WHERE v.reviewStatus = 'Approved' AND v.enable = 1
AND v.uploadDate >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
ORDER BY v.uploadDate DESC LIMIT #{limit}
